title: A thousand fewer paths to root
reason: Autonomous AI pipeline finding and patching 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities is a major AI capability result with security implications, corroborated by two sources.

sources.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

title: Global asset manager Schroders brings emerging market bond fund to Solana
reason: A $1.1T asset manager tokenizing an active bond strategy onchain is a clearly publishable adoption milestone, though single-source.

sources.summary: The global asset manager, which oversees $1.1 trillion in assets, is bringing an actively managed bond strategy onchain through tokenization specialist Centrifuge.
